events.text: Karlsøy was established as a municipality.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Karlsøy was established as a municipality on 1 January 1838

events.text: The southern Ullsfjord district of Karlsøy was transferred from Karlsøy to Lyngen Municipality.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: On 1 January 1867 , the southern Ullsfjord district of Karlsøy ( population : 862 ) was transferred from Karlsøy to the neighboring Lyngen Municipality

events.text: The western island district was separated from Karlsøy to become the new municipality of Helgøy.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: On 1 September 1886 , the western island district ( population : 828 ) was separated from Karlsøy to become the new municipality of Helgøy

events.text: The municipality of Helgøy was merged back into the municipality of Karlsøy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 January 1964 , the municipality of Helgøy was merged back into the municipality of Karlsøy

events.text: All of the mainland areas of Karlsøy were transferred from Karlsøy to neighboring Lyngen Municipality.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: At the same time , all of the mainland areas of Karlsøy ( the northern part of the Lyngen peninsula , with 1,001 inhabitants ) was transferred from Karlsøy to neighboring Lyngen Municipality

events.text: The southern part of the island of Reinøya was transferred from Tromsø Municipality to Karlsøy Municipality.
